question_text_max300: [NR-03 sub-question] Does a resazurin-type dye readout (alamarBlue, PrestoBlue) after WWOX gain or loss track cell number or respiration? Signs differ: T98G gain up (2014) but down (2023); bladder CAL-29 loss up, gain null; four glioma lines gain down; hNPC knockdown down.
decision_at_stake_max200: Decides whether any dye readout may count toward NR-03 (respiration, complex I) or only as a viability proxy; stops 'mitochondrial activity' being pooled across four signs.
status_evidence: ADV-218 result (IT, 2026-11-24) and ADV-223 result section 4; held sources: papers 36979157 (figures at caption level), 33691672 (BrdU and dye in the same lines), 25051421 (no dye number), registry PAPER 022 (hNPC, raw RFU, no n)
blocking_reason: Decisive datum is a wet-lab pair (dye normalised to cell count plus oxygen consumption in one WWOX-deficient neural line); the held-data half (figure reading of 36979157, per-line proliferation against dye) needs no spend.
